## Structure and components

- [statement] IBM Cloudability documents MongoDB resource tags as part of invoice data, without extra Cloudability permissions to enable those tags. It also synthesizes cldy:mongodb:groupid and cldy:mongodb:groupname from billing fields; those names should not be assumed to be native Atlas resource-tag keys. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/apptio-platform/datalink/saas?topic=spend-tag-label-mapping · keywords: Atlas Admin API pending-invoice tags field

## How it works

- [statement] GET /api/atlas/v2/orgs/{orgId}/invoices/pending returns invoices accruing charges for the current billing cycle. Resource tags are exposed per line item at results[].lineItems[].tags for external cost-allocation reporting. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/api/doc/atlas-admin-api-v2/operation/operation-listpendinginvoices · keywords: Atlas Admin API pending-invoice tags field · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/architecture/current/billing-data.md

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] The pending-invoice response defines tags as an object with additional properties of type array[string]. Consumers should preserve multiple string values for a key instead of assuming a scalar string or an array of key/value objects. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/api/doc/atlas-admin-api-v2/operation/operation-listpendinginvoices · keywords: Atlas Admin API pending-invoice tags field
- [statement] MongoDB invoice documentation says API and CSV tags reflect configuration when the API is invoked or the CSV is generated. Within a billing cycle, reconfigured tags appear as the latest configuration, rather than a history of tag changes. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/invoices.md · keywords: Atlas Admin API pending-invoice tags field
- [statement] For reproducible cost attribution, retain the retrieved tags with a retrieval timestamp rather than assuming repeated invoice requests preserve historical ownership. This is an implementation recommendation inferred from the documented current-configuration semantics and the billing-data integration guidance. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/invoices.md · keywords: Atlas Admin API pending-invoice tags field · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/architecture/current/billing-data.md, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/api/doc/atlas-admin-api-v2/operation/operation-listpendinginvoices
- [statement] DoiT documents automatically importing MongoDB Atlas resource tags as Cloud Analytics system labels with a mongodb/ prefix; for example, environment becomes mongodb/environment. This is a downstream mapping, rather than the native pending-invoice JSON format. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-08-21) — https://help.doit.com/docs/mongodb/mongodb-data · keywords: Atlas Admin API pending-invoice tags field

## Facts and statements

- [statement] The MongoDB launch post, updated March 11, 2025, says tags typically appear on invoice line items within 48 hours after addition and scopes eligibility to tagged cluster-level line items. Treat that timing and scope as dated guidance, not a completeness guarantee for every charge. (low confidence) (verified as of 2025-03-11) — https://www.mongodb.com/company/blog/product-release-announcements/deployment-tags-billing-invoices-now-generally-available · keywords: Atlas Admin API pending-invoice tags field
- [statement] Atlas invoice tags can categorize spending by custom business dimensions beyond project or cluster names, and the billing API can feed that line-item data into external FinOps tools. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/architecture/current/billing-data.md · keywords: Atlas Admin API pending-invoice tags field · also: https://www.mongodb.com/company/blog/product-release-announcements/deployment-tags-billing-invoices-now-generally-available
- [statement] The pending-invoice endpoint lists Organization Billing Viewer as its required role. Viewing linked invoices in a cross-organization setup requires Organization Billing Admin or Organization Owner access for the paying organization. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/api/doc/atlas-admin-api-v2/operation/operation-listpendinginvoices · keywords: Atlas Admin API pending-invoice tags field · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/architecture/current/billing-data.md
